open_points: No software safety requirements are allocated; the safety allocation status is PENDING owner alloc.
Failure handling, reset/startup behavior and safe states are not specified in the software requirements document (software_requirements.md).

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to start the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0xCCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with 0xCCCC

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to refresh the watchdog counter, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0xAAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with 0xAAAA

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to enable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with 0x5555

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to disable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write a value different from 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with any value other than 0x5555

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write a valid prescaler divider value to IWDG_PR.PR.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_PR.PR is written with a 4-bit value in range [0..15]

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the requested reload value to IWDG_RLR.RL when a function sets the watchdog reload value.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_RLR.RL is written with a 12-bit value in range [0..4095]

requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the IWDG LL driver shall not write any IWDG register.
requirements.verification: target_robot_test passes when no IWDG register is written before calling any LL function
